blocks.tamil_translation: Allah, I am the one among you all who fears Allah the most, the one among you all who is most God-conscious towards Him; yet I fast,’ and I also leave fasting, I pray and I also sleep, and I also marry women. (This is my way.) So whoever turns away from my way is not of me!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ تَمَسَّكَ بِسُنَّتِي عِنْدَ فَسَادِ أُمَّتِي فَلَهُ أَجْرُ شَهِيدٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني باسناد لاباس به الترغيب:٨٠/١
blocks.tamil_translation: ““Whoever holds firmly to my way (Sunnah) at the time when my Ummah has become corrupt will receive the reward of a shahid (martyr)!” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ:تَرَكْتُ فِيكُمْ أَمْرَيْنِ لَنْ تَضِلُّوا مَا تَمَسَّكْتُمْ بِهِمَا كِتَابُ اللهِ وَسُنَّةُ نَبِيِّهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مالك في الموطا , النهي عن القول في القدر ص:٧٠٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “I am leaving two things with you. As long as you hold firmly to both of them, you will not go astray. They are the Book of Allah and the way (Sunnah) of His Prophet.” Hazrat Malik ibn Anas (RA) says that this hadith of the Prophet ﷺ reached him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْعِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: وَعَظَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ يَوْماً بَعْدَ صَلوةِ الْغَدَاةِ مَوْعِظَةً بَلِيغَةً ذَرَفَتْ مِنْهَا الْعُيُونُ وَوَجِلَتْ
